description:
Author the formal-proof sketch naming, for each obligation, the exact production path, lemma statements, and proof strategy: extension embedding/restriction and relative-Frobenius laws, quotient reduction, cyclotomic closure, generator base-field/root correctness, and systematic encoding correctness.

## Background

The repository requires an approved sketch before proof code, and the sketch must name exact production files and functions — so it lands after the semantic production paths exist. The current extraction surface makes raw bounded gf2m paths transparent while runtime field-carrying code and the polynomial module are opaque; the sketch therefore assigns each obligation to direct extraction or to an abstract Lean model with tested refinement to the optimized Rust paths, per the plan's refinement-boundary contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The sketch names, per obligation, the production path (file and function), the lemma statements, the proof strategy, and whether it binds by extraction or by model-plus-refinement, consistent with the current extraction surface.
- [hard] REQ-02: Refinement obligations name their equivalence evidence (differential test or extracted witness) and no obligation rests on an untracked assumption.
title: Author the formal-proof sketch for the algebraic foundations
